summary: The is_link test checks whether a path is an existing symlink on the controller.
questions: How do I check if a local path is a symlink?
Is is_link the same as link?

answer_card.title: is_link test (controller paths)
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.is_link` (same as `link`): true if the path is an existing symlink on the **controller**.
